questions.prompt: Who was asked about activity in the survey?
options: Children attending sports clubs in England.
Parents and guardians of young children in England.
Sports teachers working in British schools.
questions.explanationZh: s5说明对象是英格兰七至十一岁儿童的家长和监护人，并非儿童本人、教师或全英国青少年家长。

questions.prompt: Why does the campaign suggest short periods of movement?
options: Some parents say they do not have enough time.
Most children already take part every day.
The survey only studied ten-minute lessons.
Families asked for longer sports lessons.
questions.explanationZh: s8的时间不足与s9的therefore构成明确原因关系；没有说调查只研究十分钟课程。

questions.prompt: What is the campaign’s main approach in this article?
options: Help families improve a familiar sport before trying another.
Use regular lessons to compare parents’ and children’s progress.
Treat a short period together as the complete daily activity goal.
Start together and build activity without needing to be skilled.
questions.explanationZh: 正文强调无需先擅长、先短时开始并增加活动量，核心是共同参与而非成绩比较。
